$comment: Which gap-register row (or retirement-ledger capability, as 'ledger:<capability>', or a rename, as 'renamed:<new surface id>') each removed surface belongs to. This file approves nothing: surface-guard looks the row up in tsai-sitedocs PLAT-DATA-EPIC-REAL-DATA-FOUNDATION/gap-register.md and retirement-ledger.md, and refuses a missing, foreign or CLOSED row. A key ending in '*' covers every surface id with that prefix. Evidence for each mapping: the deleting PR and GA-030 appendix D.
